description: This file defines a PHP class `ADODB_odbtp_unicode` that extends another class, customizing it for Unicode support in the 'odbtp' database driver. It includes licensing information, dependencies, and a deprecated status note.

classes.name: ADODB_odbtp_unicode
classes.description: A class extending the `ADODB_odbtp` class to support Unicode SQL in the ODBTP driver, indicating Unicode usage via the `_useUnicodeSQL` property.

methods.name: ADODB_odbtp_unicode
methods.description: Constructor that sets the database type and enables Unicode SQL support.
